name: AI Data Firewall: Governed AI Intake

parameters.content:
## 🛡️ AI Data Firewall
Governed AI intake for regulated industries.

**Nothing reaches a model until policy says so. Everything is logged.**

Run Demo = 19 synthetic messages. Webhook = POST {text, channel, customer_name} or {messages:[...]}

### 1. Know what you have
Normalise every channel, load the versioned **Policy Register**, detect PII (checksum-validated cards, TFN, Medicare), sensitive context and prompt injection.

### 2. Control what AI sees
Purpose limitation, approved-model check, tokenise or redact per data class, residual PII re-scan. Crisis or unapproved purpose = **AI blocked, human only**.

### 3. Trust nothing coming back
Schema validation, leak detection, invented-token check, confidence threshold, SLA clock + routing.

### 4. Prove it
Audit ledger (hashes, no raw PII), tokenised case queue, restricted token vault. Every row stamped with policy version + prompt hash.
